verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API, backed by an OpenAPI spec, for creating and managing resources and launching instances programmatically. Cloud-init handles launch-time configuration, and instances are reachable over SSH, so the core of headless automation is delivered. Managed Slurm and Kubernetes add scriptable job execution on clusters, and a community-built unofficial CLI/MCP server shows agents driving the API. Missing for 10: an official first-party CLI, CI-specific integration docs or examples (e.g. pipeline setup, API-key handling in CI), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
